claims: WrestleMania 42 is scheduled for April 18–19, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 is scheduled at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, Nevada.
Tickets for WrestleMania 42 are currently available through On Location.
WrestleMania Saturday of WrestleMania 42 is April 18, 2026.
WrestleMania Sunday of WrestleMania 42 is April 19, 2026.
As of April 10, 2026, the Undisputed WWE Championship match on WrestleMania Saturday is Cody Rhodes (c) vs. Randy Orton (with Pat McAfee).
As of April 10, 2026, the Women’s World Championship match on WrestleMania Saturday is Stephanie Vaquer (c) vs. Liv Morgan.
As of April 10, 2026, the Intercontinental Championship match on WrestleMania Saturday is Gunther vs. Seth Rollins.
As of April 10, 2026, the Women’s Intercontinental Title match on WrestleMania Saturday is AJ Lee (c) vs. Becky Lynch.

As of April 10, 2026, the WWE Women’s Tag Team Championship match on WrestleMania Saturday is Nia Jax & Lash Legend (c) vs. Charlotte Flair & Alexa Bliss vs. Bayley & Lyra Valkyria vs. The Bella Twins.
As of April 10, 2026, the Unsanctioned Match on WrestleMania Saturday is Drew McIntyre vs. Jacob Fatu.
As of April 10, 2026, the Six-Man Tag Team Match on WrestleMania Saturday is Logan Paul, Austin Theory & IShowSpeed vs. The Usos & LA Knight.
As of April 10, 2026, the World Heavyweight Championship match on WrestleMania Sunday is CM Punk (c) vs. Roman Reigns.
As of April 10, 2026, the WWE Women’s Championship match on WrestleMania Sunday is Jade Cargill (c) vs. Rhea Ripley.
As of April 10, 2026, the U.S. Championship match on WrestleMania Sunday is Sami Zayn (c) vs. Trick Williams.
As of April 10, 2026, the Singles Match on WrestleMania Sunday is "The Demon" Finn Bálor vs. Dominik Mysterio.
Both nights of WrestleMania 42 start at 6 p.m. ET / 3 p.m. PT.
Official Ticket Packages for WrestleMania 42, including Priority Pass with premium seating and hospitality, are available.
WrestleMania 42 streams live on Peacock in the U.S.
WrestleMania 42 streams live on Disney+ / ESPN+ Bundle in some regions.
Match cards for WrestleMania 42 are subject to change based on the latest WWE SmackDown results.
